data.text: אני איתך. הבנתי: מה זה תודעה

understanding: Current main baseline only; preserve verified public design/functionality; fix highest-value safe regression without changing product behavior.

understanding: IMA already had canonical ZERO, truth states, reflection, learning, feedback and human-agency contracts; the missing piece was one explicit evidence-bounded epistemic decision record connecting them.
action: Merged PR #156. Added ima_runtime/epistemic_state.py as a child component of the canonical reflection runtime; integrated it into reflection_runtime; added canonical contract fields and narrow regression tests.
completion: code change merged to main; narrow epistemic tests passed locally; main contains the new canonical mechanism.
quality: No UI redesign, no older version revived, no parallel authority created. Default truth state is UNKNOWN; evidence/verification are required for stronger claims; meaning and human choice remain separate from empirical truth.
blocker: No GitHub Actions workflow run/status was associated with the merge commit; gh-pages public version remains the prior verified SHA, so the new runtime change is not declared live.
cause: No canonical deployment/public-runtime verification occurred for this backend/runtime change.
approval_dependency: none for code change; deployment/live claim remains evidence-gated.
current_state: New mechanism is canonical on main but not publicly deployed/verified.
next_action: Use the canonical deployment path only; require deployed SHA, public version.json, and real-browser runtime smoke evidence before calling the mechanism live.

understanding: The unified epistemic mechanism is now implemented as a child of the existing canonical reflection runtime; it does not create a second brain, memory authority, feedback authority, or ZERO authority.
action: Canonical Render service auto-deployed the main commit containing the mechanism. Firecrawl interactive live browser verified the public IMA site loads and verified the IMA API /health endpoint returns status ok.
completion: backend/runtime deployment is live; public website UI remains on the previously verified gh-pages version because this change intentionally did not alter the UI.
quality: Narrow tests passed; contract/static integration checks passed; Render deploy is live; interactive browser smoke passed for public site and API health. Chat-authenticated end-to-end epistemic record verification was not performed because it would require an authenticated session and potentially create persistent interaction data.
blocker: Opera connector unavailable (browser not connected). WebMCP on public page reports not activated in this environment. Firecrawl live browser is available and was used as the permitted fallback.
cause: interactive browser connection hierarchy: Google session unavailable, Collaboration Bridge not authenticated in this run, Opera disconnected; Firecrawl available.
approval_dependency: none for this reversible runtime change; no payments, purchases, irreversible permissions, or external publishing performed.
